notes: Prices checked against OpenRouter GET /models on 2026-11-22. Chat cost order is prompt price. Image cost order is image_output (prompt is 0 on most still-image ids). Video prompt price is 0 on the API; order uses the public per-second price.
Safety chat is is_moderated=true and tool+JSON capable: GPT-5 Nano, GPT-5 Mini, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Opus 5.5. Opus is the high-refusal flagship. GPT-5.5 costs more and is not used as max.

Balanced chat is a capable default with tools and JSON, not an uncensored specialist and not Claude/GPT. Low is Llama 3.1 8B (cheapest that still calls tools). Medium is DeepSeek V4 Pro. High is Gemini 4 Neon. Max is Muse Wonder.

Uncensored chat: only two catalog ids say uncensored in the name or description — Dolphin Mistral 24B Venice Edition (prompt $0.20/M, response_format, no tools) and Cydonia 24B v4.1 (prompt $0.30/M, response_format and structured_outputs, no tools). Both are on GET /models?zdr=true. No larger uncensored model exists, so high and max repeat Cydonia. Llama-instruct, Claude, and GPT are not in this row.
Uncensored agent keeps Dolphin and Cydonia even though supported_parameters lacks tools and tool_choice. Tool calls may be weaker. Alignment wins over the tools-only filter for that row.
Router and agent ZDR columns match default because every chosen chat id is on GET /models?zdr=true.
Safety image (ZDR off) is moderated GPT Image. gpt-5.4-image-2 shares gpt-image-2's image token price and is the high cell because it adds GPT-5.4. Max is gpt-5-image, the highest GPT image price.

Safety image ZDR: no is_moderated=true image id is on GET /models?output_modalities=image&zdr=true (GPT Image is moderated but absent). Cells use Google image ids in prompt-price order as the moderated-vendor stand-in, not as uncensored.
Balanced image (ZDR off) is Seedream, then Gemini 3 Pro Image as max. Flux is reserved for uncensored. GPT Image is reserved for safety.
Balanced image ZDR is Microsoft MAI (on the ZDR image catalog, not Flux, not GPT). Order follows image_output price: 2.7 Flash, 2.7, 2.5, 2.5 Pro.

Uncensored image (ZDR off) is Flux, the least-moderated image family. image_output order: FLUX 3 Klein, FLUX.2 Klein 4B, FLUX.2 Pro, FLUX 3 Image. FLUX.2 Max costs more than FLUX 3 Image; max is FLUX 3 Image because it is the flagship, not the pricier older tier.

Uncensored image ZDR: Flux is not on the ZDR image catalog. Krea is (is_moderated=false). Krea 2 Large is the largest and is described as lighter post-training. No higher Krea tier exists, so max repeats krea-2-large.
Safety video is Google Veo. Per-second price: Lite $0.05, Fast $0.10, Veo 3.1 $0.40. No Veo above 3.1 exists, so max repeats Veo 3.1.
Balanced video is general text-to-video that is not Veo and not the uncensored row. Per-second price: Wan 3.0 $0.03, Seedance 2.5 Flash $0.067, Seedance 2.5 $0.103, Runway Gen-4.5 $0.12.

No video id is named uncensored, and top_provider.is_moderated is false for every video model including Veo. Uncensored video is the least safety-lab ladder: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite $0.02, Grok Imagine Video $0.05, Grok Imagine Video 1.5 $0.08, FLUX.3 Video $0.17.

GET /models?output_modalities=video&zdr=true returned 0 models, and no video id appears on GET /models?zdr=true. Every video ZDR cell repeats the non-ZDR pick so the cell is not blank. Those ids are not ZDR routes; OpenRouter may reject them when ZDR or deny-collection is on.
